mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_name, email, department_id, role, password FROM users ORDER BY user_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, user_name, email, department_id, role, password) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{email}, #{departmentId}, #{role}, #{password})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_name = #{userName}, email = #{email}, department_id = #{departmentId}, role = #{role}, password = #{password} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
